info.title: Singer Social Media API
info.description: Backend API for the singer social media React Native app (auth + tracks).

post.description: Create a new user account and return access/refresh tokens.
Authenticate with email and password.
Exchange a refresh token for a new access/refresh token pair.
Send a 6-digit email OTP if the account exists. Always returns a generic success message.
Verify the email OTP and return a short-lived reset token.
Set a new password using the reset token from OTP verification.

get.description: Return the authenticated user's edit/bootstrap profile (me DTO).

patch.description: Patch dirty text fields (name, bio, username) and optional preferredGenres (0 or 1–6 TRACK_GENRES ids). Username changes respect the 7-day cooldown.

get.description: Returns whether a username is available. The caller's own username counts as available.

post.description: Presign a PUT URL for uploading an avatar image to R2.
Verify the uploaded avatar object and set it as the current user's avatar.
Presign a PUT URL for uploading a cover image to R2.
Verify the uploaded cover object and set it as the current user's cover.

delete.description: Remove the current user's cover image.

post.description: Create signed upload URLs for mix, stems, and sources (used by backup/sync).

get.description: List the authenticated user's tracks, optionally filtered by status.

post.description: Create a DRAFT track metadata row (LOCAL_ONLY). Audio stays on device until backup.

get.description: Fetch a single track by id (owner only).

patch.description: Update DRAFT track metadata and layers (owner only).

delete.description: Delete a track and its storage files (owner only).

post.description: Signed URLs to upload local mix, stems, and sources to Supabase.
Verify uploaded objects and mark track storageState as SYNCED.
Delete orphaned storage objects from a failed backup while the track remains LOCAL_ONLY with mixPath null. Does not delete the track row.

get.summary: List published tracks for a user

post.description: Add a PUBLISHED track to Liked Songs. Idempotent; likeCount bumps only on first like.

delete.description: Remove a track from Liked Songs. Idempotent; likeCount drops only when a like existed.

get.description: Viewer's Liked Songs, newest first. Unpublished tracks stay listed with available=false.
Owner's playlists by updatedAt desc. coverFallbackUrls holds up to 4 playable track covers for a client collage when no custom cover is set.
Visible to the owner, or to anyone when PUBLIC; otherwise 404. Tracks no longer PUBLISHED return available=false.

delete.description: Removes the playlist and its join rows; tracks are untouched.

post.description: Appends PUBLISHED tracks from any artist. Already-attached tracks are skipped.

put.description: trackIds must be a permutation of the current members.

post.description: Creates a DRAFT album.

get.description: Owner's albums (DRAFT and RELEASED). coverFallbackUrl is the first track's cover when no custom cover is set.
Owner always; others only when RELEASED (otherwise 404). Tracks no longer PUBLISHED return available=false.

delete.description: Removes the album and its join rows; tracks are untouched.

post.description: Sets status RELEASED and releasedAt on first release. Rejects empty albums with 400.
Returns the album to DRAFT; releasedAt and tracks are kept.
Appends the owner's PUBLISHED tracks. 409 if a track already belongs to another album.

put.description: trackIds must be a permutation of the current members.

post.description: Bookmark another user's PUBLIC playlist. Idempotent; saveCount bumps only on first save. 400 for own playlist, 404 when private or missing.

delete.description: Remove a saved playlist. Idempotent; saveCount drops only when a save existed.

post.description: Bookmark another user's RELEASED album. Idempotent. 400 for own album, 404 when not released or missing.

get.description: Viewer's saved playlists, newest first. Playlists that are no longer PUBLIC stay listed with available=false.
Viewer's saved albums, newest first. Albums that are no longer RELEASED stay listed with available=false.
Top-level comments with nested replies. Track must be PUBLISHED. `sort=newest` (default) or `top` (by likeCount); replies are oldest first.

post.description: Comment on a PUBLISHED track. Set `parentId` to reply; parent must be a top-level comment on the same track (replies to replies return 400).

delete.description: Hard delete (author only). Deleting a top-level comment also removes its replies; returns the updated track `commentCount`.

post.description: Idempotent. Comment's track must be PUBLISHED.

delete.description: Idempotent. Comment's track must be PUBLISHED.

get.description: Returns the viewer's most recently updated project summary, or null when they have none.
Search users by username or display name. Excludes the authenticated viewer.
Public profile with follower/following counts and relationship flags for the viewer.

post.description: Follow a user. Idempotent if already following.

delete.description: Unfollow a user. Idempotent if not following.

get.description: Return isFollowing / isFollowedBy / isMutual for the viewer vs target user.
Paginated list of users who follow the target user. Newest follows first.
Paginated list of users the target user follows. Newest follows first.

get.summary: Search songs, playlists, and albums in one ranked list

get.description: Search PUBLISHED tracks by title, caption, or artist username/name.
Search PUBLIC playlists by title, description, or owner username/name.
Search RELEASED albums by title, description, or artist username/name.
List the viewer's recent searches (artists, songs, albums, playlists; max 20).

post.description: Upsert a recent search (artist or media) and trim to the last 20 entries.

delete.description: Delete all recent searches for the authenticated user.
Delete a single recent search entry owned by the viewer.

post.summary: Create or renew a message request
Create signed upload URL for a voice note
Mint a short-lived realtime join token

get.description: Public catalog of artists with ≥1 PUBLISHED track in the last 30 days, ordered by followerCount then latest publish.
Public catalog of PUBLISHED tracks from the last 30 days, sorted by playCount desc.
Auth-required heuristic recommendations from preferredGenres + recent TrackPlay (+ likes). Cold start falls back to fresh 14d publishes.

200.description: Made for you tracks fetched successfully

get.description: Viewer's owned playlists plus available saved playlists, most recently touched first (owned updatedAt vs saved savedAt).
Cursor-paginated PUBLISHED tracks with mix, ordered by publishedAt desc. Auth required.
Cursor-paginated inbox for the authenticated user.
Badge count. Also available as `unreadNotificationCount` on GET /api/user.

post.description: Mark specific ids, or omit/empty `ids` to mark all unread as read.

get.description: Auth-required history of distinct PUBLISHED tracks the viewer played recently (TrackPlay), most recent first.
